_comment: Candidate locators, tried in order until one becomes visible. Sign-in/OTP/CAPTCHA entries are carried over from AdFlow, where they were verified against the live Amazon pages. The reporting/history entries are UNVERIFIED best guesses: run 'python run.py --inspect-page' once, and when a run fails naming a key, put the working selector at the TOP of that key's list. No code change needed. Any Playwright selector engine works: css, xpath=, text=, role=, and '>>' chaining.
_note_otp: Amazon's Two-Step Verification page, verified against the live page on 2026-09-19. The OTP box is <input id='auth-mfa-otpcode' name='otpCode' type='tel'>, the submit is <input id='auth-signin-button' name='mfaSubmit'>, and 'Don't require code on this browser' is <input id='auth-mfa-remember-device' name='rememberDevice'>. Ticking that box is what stops later scheduled runs from hitting MFA again, so it matters more than it looks.
_note_captcha: Split out of security_challenge_marker: an image CAPTCHA is the one challenge a terminal cannot answer, so the interactive login has to tell it apart from an OTP.
_note_history: UNVERIFIED. reporting/history?reportId=... shows the saved report with a 'Run report' action and a table of past runs, newest first; a pending run's status is '-' and a finished one offers Download.
_note_live_2026_10_20: VERIFIED on the live page 2026-10-20 with AMAZON_ENTITY_ID set (signed in). Without entityId the report area shows 'Sorry, something went wrong'. Page: 'Close report', an 'Actions' dropdown (entries: Run, Copy, Delete), tabs 'Report history' / 'Report settings'. History is an AG Grid, newest run first, columns: Report status | Date created | Report period | Sent to | Actions. A pending run shows status 'Processing' and '-' in Actions; a finished one shows 'Completed' and a Download link. No standalone 'Run report' button exists.
_note_run_menu_item: VERIFIED 2026-10-20: the Actions menu holds Run, Copy and Delete. Anchored to the exact word 'Run' so it can never match Delete or Copy.
_note_rows: Data rows of the run-history table, newest first. Header rows must not match.
_note_download: VERIFIED 2026-10-20: a 'Download' link inside the newest row. Evaluated INSIDE that row only, so an older run's link is never used.
